9. RISKS BEFORE MOVING OR DELETING ANYTHING
-------------------------------------------
- Preserve CSV provenance and backup copies until hash-based deduplication is
  approved and a recovery plan exists.
- Paths are referenced directly by scripts; moving data without updating and
  testing every reader can break the app/audits.
- Stage reports and backups are audit evidence and should be archived, not
  discarded casually.
- The two virtual environments may differ in installed dependencies.  Confirm
  the active interpreter and create a dependency manifest before consolidation.
- Do not treat historical threshold data or ML-related audit files as admission
  outcome data or trained models.
